task_instructions: Bring red block to the center, then stack green block over it.
Center red block using the left arm, then stack green block with the left arm on top.
Place red block and green block in the center, then stack green block above red block.
Use the right arm to move red block and the right arm to position green block.
Utilize the left arm to grab red block and the right arm to grab green block, move them to the middle, and stack green block above red block.
